terrainDescription.zh: 南部熱帶雨林與沿海，北部轉為薩赫爾稀樹草原
terrainDescription.en: Tropical rainforest and coast in the south, transitioning to Sahelian savanna in the north

plate.color: black text on white (private); black-on-yellow (commercial); format "AS 2567-12" (region code + number + year)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Black-and-white striped bollards common in cities; rural roads mostly use plain unpainted metal signposts instead

utilityPole.transformerMount: 3 insulators on a metal crossbar (visually similar to Kenya's poles)

historicalContext.zh: 迦納是撒哈拉以南非洲第一個獨立的前殖民地（1957年），阿善提王國歷史深刻影響當地文化認同。
historicalContext.en: Ghana was the first Sub-Saharan African colony to gain independence (1957); the Ashanti Kingdom's history deeply shapes local cultural identity.

note.zh: 肯特布（Kente cloth，鮮豔幾何條紋）源自阿善提族，是迦納最具代表性的紡織品，但主要用於慶典場合，日常街景較少見；蠟染布同樣廣泛使用，跨國界不具辨識力。
note.en: Kente cloth (bright geometric stripes) originates with the Ashanti and is Ghana's most iconic textile, but mainly worn at ceremonies, not everyday scenes. Wax-print fabric is also common but not distinctive since it spans multiple countries.

culturalMarkers.caveat: Mainly ceremonial — rarely seen in ordinary street scenes
